name: SP3ND — Stablecoin purchasing agent
description: Create server-priced physical-goods orders, wait for manual quotes when required, select server-provided shipping options, and pay payment-ready orders with stablecoins through x402.

SP3ND_API_SECRET.description: API secret from POST /registerAgent (shown once — save immediately)

SP3ND_USER_WALLET.description: Optional end-user wallet attribution included on carts and orders

AGENT_WALLET_PATH.description: Path to Solana wallet JSON file (defaults to ./.wallet.json)

solana_wallet.description: Solana keypair holding USDC — the agent generates this autonomously, then a human funds it

security.spending_note: An agent may submit payment without per-transaction human approval only after SP3ND marks the order payment-ready and returns a current server-authoritative quote and x402 payment requirement. Apply spending limits, preserve idempotency keys, and never retry an uncertain payment without first reading the order.
